Messages.Author: Loadquo
Messages.Body:
Drawing Out The Beast

Only usable before range is determined on the first round. Frenzy.
[ani] During this combat, opposing vampire gets +1 strength, but he or
she cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to long range, cannot use presses
to end combat and cannot use equipment. *A vampire may play only 1
Drawing Out the Beast each combat.*

Aye

Master: trifle. Put this card on a Laibon. This Laibon may tap this
card to cancel a Frenzy card played on him or her as it is played.
..etc

Does the cancelling of the frenzy card cancel the, "A vampire can only
play 1 drawing out the beast each combat," section of drawing? Or could
a vampire play another one after Aye has canceled it?

Will Pearson

Messages.Author: quetzalcoatl
Messages.Body:
The key phrase here is "as it is played"

Since it is cancelled "as it is played" the card is already played and
thus cannot be replayed this combat.

The same concept goes for a Direct Intervention cancelling a modifier
or reaction card.

David

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:



That clause on the second copy of DotB prevents it from being played.
